notes: Changes title, next_action, notes, estimate_minutes or repeat (see update_task_clear_repeat.json) (at least one; the same limits as create_task) of a task this persona created that the owner has not yet kept or removed, or of a task assigned to the persona (tag agent:<persona>, including one it created for its own queue). Anything else is not_assigned; a task outside the subtree, or one the owner removed, is wrong_scope; a closed task is invalid_request. The owner's client applies the change on its next poll (a new estimate in minutes replaces an exact duration). Like any call carrying task, it renews the session's lease. request_id makes a retry safe.
